MUKESH JHA

Experienced in Regulatory Assurance, regulatory change assessment, client asset safeguarding, control testing, and implementation of regulatory requirements across Securities Services, Custody, and global transaction-processing operations.

Mumbai | jha7524mukesh@gmail.com | +91-8779191674

PROFILE SUMMARY



Seasoned and detail-oriented Finance Operations Professional with over 14 years of comprehensive experience in global transaction processing, custodian banking operations, and securities settlement. Currently designated as Team Leader / Assistant Manager at State Street Corporate Services, a premier global custodian bank, managing critical financial operations and supporting clients across India, APAC, EMEA and North America.

Demonstrates in-depth expertise in both trade, cash operations and payment investigation encompassing electronic trade processing, security movement, and post-trade lifecycle management. Proficient in handling cash receipts and disbursements via SWIFT (MT202), foreign exchange settlements, netting, and fee-based fund transfers. Experienced in a wide range of financial instruments including equity, fixed income securities, mutual funds, derivatives, and money market instruments such as CPs, CDs, and repos. Possesses sound knowledge about the different clearinghouses like CREST, EUROCLEAR, DTC, FED and so on to enable securities settlement.

Demonstrates in-depth expertise in wealth management/financial planning platform in handling international

customers/process. Already worked as a client facing role in one of the top custodian bank State Street Corporate Services and have excellent client service delivery experience. Worked in US Time zone follow client holiday calendar. Proficiency in MS Office, Worked on Bloomberg, Reuters, IDC, JPM, Markit.

• Demonstrates in-depth expertise in Project Management experience for the Wealth Management domain. • Strong ‘’ASANA’’ tool knowledge/usage or experience in any other ‘’Work Management Platform’’ for effectively managing and collaborating on tasks and projects. Fluent in MSFT (Microsoft Office 365) suite.

• Highly skilled in error/claim analysis, MIS reporting, and SLA-based service delivery, with a strong record of client



interfacing, particularly with operations and service teams across the UK and US. Possesses deep understanding of Regulatory Assurance, Regulatory Compliance & Regulatory Change Known for identifying and mitigating operational risks, driving process standardization, supporting transitions of banking products within international trade, and facilitating compliance and audit reviews. Successfully formulated new policies and procedures, driving business growth, cost-reduction, and efficiency improvements through structured process redesign, resource planning, and productivity management.

Demonstrated success in planning and executing banking-related processes, maximizing account profitability, improving liquidity positions, and delivering enhanced returns. Strong experience in developing operational strategies, defining SLA/KPI frameworks, ensuring TAT compliance, and aligning manpower effectively to deliver seamless service. Played a strategic role in client relationship management, building service standards for operational excellence, and leading initiatives that enhanced customer experience and retention. Recognized as a visionary professional capable of driving organizational transformation, developing AOPs, and contributing directly to top-line and bottom-line growth. • Accomplished in project management, successfully leading the entire project lifecycle from planning to delivery, while ensuring cost optimization, interdisciplinary coordination, and documentation compliance. Acted as a key contributor in multiple successful process migrations, including North American transactions, image application, and the GTM Blotter to TXR system transition. Served as BCP Coordinator and SharePoint Committee Representative, ensuring business continuity and SOP governance.



Renowned for implementing strong internal controls, conducting risk assessments, and executing quality audits. Excelled

at mentoring teams, leading up to 10 professionals, facilitating performance improvement through training workshops, and embedding LEAN initiatives that earned multiple performance and innovation awards.

Notable for championing process transformation—identifying inefficiencies, redesigning workflows, and enhancing

service delivery with measurable gains in efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Known for leading change management initiatives, attaining breakthrough performance levels, and enhancing operational quality standards.

Holds an M.Com degree along with Company Secretary Executive certification. Open to leveraging this versatile experience across investment operations, O2C/R2R functions, middle-office roles, fund accounting, or risk and compliance functions—ideally based in Mumbai or Pune, while remaining open to broader opportunities within financial operations and shared services environments. CORE COMPETENCIES

Global Transaction Processing • • • • Mutual Funds & Money Market Instruments (CP, CD, Repos) • Cross-Border Fund Transfers & Client Communication • Regulatory Compliance, KYC / AML Awareness & Due Diligence • Risk Assessment, Internal Controls & Control Testing • • Auditing, Reconciliation & Escalation Management • MIS Reporting, SLA & KPI Monitoring • • • • • • EDUCATION

Securities Settlement & Custody Operations Trade Finance & Foreign Exchange (FX) Settlement (SWIFT MT Series) Equity, Fixed Income & Derivative Instruments

Fraud Detection & Exception Handling

Strategic Planning & Business Operations Excellence

Cost Saving, Resource & Operational Optimization

Continuous Process Improvement (Lean Six Sigma)

Process Migration, System Transition & Automation

Project Management & Delivery Excellence

Team Building, Leadership, Coaching & Mentoring

M.Com (2004) – Marathwada University, Aurangabad, Maharashtra – 72% •

Company Secretary Executive (Passed - 2009) | Company Secretary Professional Programme – Attempted

WORK EXPERIENCE

State Street Corporate Services Mumbai Pvt. Ltd. | Team Leader / Assistant Manager – Global Transaction Processing | Since 2008

Leadership & People Management





Leading a cross-functional team to ensure timely and error-free execution of trades across asset classes, consistently achieving 100% SLA adherence and high accuracy. Conducting targeted performance reviews and designing customized training interventions that improved underperformers’ productivity.

Recognized with 9 Manager Awards, 3 “Titan of the Month” awards, and 4 Converge Performance Awards (Q4 2014,

Q1/Q2/Q4 2015) for exceptional leadership and delivery.

Risk & Control Management



Spearheaded risk assessments, internal control testing, and root cause analysis of processing errors; introduced control measures that reduced error rates.

Actively escalated and resolved control weaknesses, enabling data-driven decision-making across trade processing





operations. Conducted Regulatory Assurance reviews across securities and custody operations to assess adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, internal policies, procedures, and operational controls. Performed regulatory and control assessments, identifying compliance/control gaps, assessing associated risks, and driving remediation actions through to closure.

•





Conducted control testing and effectiveness reviews to validate the design and operating effectiveness of key operational controls and ensure ongoing regulatory alignment. Supported monitoring of regulatory changes, assessing their potential impact on custody, securities settlement, and transaction-processing activities and coordinating required process/control changes. Served as a Control Oversight Team Member (2011), ensuring strict compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal SOPs.

Operational Excellence & Transformation

Played a pivotal role in the migration of multiple critical processes including: • North American Region Operations and Image Application from State Street Pune. • GTM Blotter to TXR Application, enhancing trade visibility and reducing turnaround time. •

Initiated and led multiple LEAN projects, earning the Top Lean Idea Award (2014) for the highest number of process improvement suggestions.

Delivered $xxxK+ in operational efficiencies through automation, improved MIS reporting, and trade lifecycle

optimizations.

Securities & Trade Processing

Managed end-to-end security settlement instructions across equities, fixed income, mutual funds, and derivatives. • Processed money market instruments including CPs, CDs, and bi-party repos; handled internal fund transfers, CUSIP switchovers, and cross-border transactions. Supported client asset safeguarding controls across securities custody and settlement operations, ensuring appropriate controls over client securities, transactions, reconciliations, and settlement activities. Ensured adherence to operational controls designed to support the protection and safeguarding of client assets throughout the securities settlement and custody lifecycle. Ensured accurate trade accounting and fund setup to support NAV calculations and client reporting.







Client Relationship Management



Liaised with clients and service teams across UK & US geographies to resolve trade exceptions, settlements, and custody operations queries.

Delivered real-time equity and cash position updates and investment advice, earning commendations from clients for

timely settlement of high-value trades.

Governance & Compliance

Maintained audit-ready MIS dashboards (daily/weekly/monthly productivity reports) and timesheets for operational

transparency.

BCP Coordinator for the unit and member of Quick Response Team, ensuring seamless continuity during disruptions. • Managed the end-to-end implementation of regulatory requirements, including impact assessment, control/process changes, SOP updates, implementation, testing, and remediation.

Reviewed and updated policies, procedures and SOPs in response to regulatory requirements and process changes,





ensuring alignment with compliance and operational control standards. Supported Regulatory Assurance and compliance reviews, maintaining audit-ready documentation, evidence, control assessments, and remediation tracking. Partnered with relevant stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into operational controls and process changes, ensuring effective implementation and sustainable compliance.

• Member of the SharePoint SOP Committee, accountable for timely documentation and updates of all standard processes.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

• MS Office Suite: Proficient in Excel, Word, PowerPoint

MIS & Dashboard Tools: Excel-based dashboards and reporting • Internet Applications: Web-based workflow tools and research • SWIFT Messaging: MT202, MT series • Securities Platforms: Trade settlement and custody systems • KPI/SLA Tools: Tracking and analysis for performance optimization • Compliance Systems: KYC/AML tools and documentation platforms SOFT SKILLS

• Decision-Making & Problem-Solving • Negotiation & Persuasion • Active Listening & Effective Communication • Stakeholder & Relationship Management • Communication & Executive Presence • Leadership & People Development • Emotional Intelligence & Cultural Awareness • Conflict Management • High Business Ethics & Trustworthy PERSONAL DETAILS

Strategic Thinking & Visionary Leadership

Languages Known: English, Hindi & Marathi • Address: Thane, 401107, Mumbai, Maharashtra

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
State Street Corporate Services Mumbai Pvt. Ltd. | Team Leader / Assistant Manager – Global Transaction Processing | Since 2008
Leadership & People Management


Leading a cross-functional team to ensure timely and error-free execution of trades across asset classes, consistently achieving 100% SLA adherence and high accuracy. Conducting targeted performance reviews and designing customized training interventions that improved underperformers’ productivity.
Recognized with 9 Manager Awards, 3 “Titan of the Month” awards, and 4 Converge Performance Awards (Q4 2014,
Q1/Q2/Q4 2015) for exceptional leadership and delivery.
Risk & Control Management

Spearheaded risk assessments, internal control testing, and root cause analysis of processing errors; introduced control measures that reduced error rates.
Actively escalated and resolved control weaknesses, enabling data-driven decision-making across trade processing


operations. Conducted Regulatory Assurance reviews across securities and custody operations to assess adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, internal policies, procedures, and operational controls. Performed regulatory and control assessments, identifying compliance/control gaps, assessing associated risks, and driving remediation actions through to closure.
•


Conducted control testing and effectiveness reviews to validate the design and operating effectiveness of key operational controls and ensure ongoing regulatory alignment. Supported monitoring of regulatory changes, assessing their potential impact on custody, securities settlement, and transaction-processing activities and coordinating required process/control changes. Served as a Control Oversight Team Member (2011), ensuring strict compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal SOPs.
Operational Excellence & Transformation
Played a pivotal role in the migration of multiple critical processes including: • North American Region Operations and Image Application from State Street Pune. • GTM Blotter to TXR Application, enhancing trade visibility and reducing turnaround time. •
Initiated and led multiple LEAN projects, earning the Top Lean Idea Award (2014) for the highest number of process improvement suggestions.
Delivered $xxxK+ in operational efficiencies through automation, improved MIS reporting, and trade lifecycle
optimizations.
Securities & Trade Processing
Managed end-to-end security settlement instructions across equities, fixed income, mutual funds, and derivatives. • Processed money market instruments including CPs, CDs, and bi-party repos; handled internal fund transfers, CUSIP switchovers, and cross-border transactions. Supported client asset safeguarding controls across securities custody and settlement operations, ensuring appropriate controls over client securities, transactions, reconciliations, and settlement activities. Ensured adherence to operational controls designed to support the protection and safeguarding of client assets throughout the securities settlement and custody lifecycle. Ensured accurate trade accounting and fund setup to support NAV calculations and client reporting.



Client Relationship Management

Liaised with clients and service teams across UK & US geographies to resolve trade exceptions, settlements, and custody operations queries.
Delivered real-time equity and cash position updates and investment advice, earning commendations from clients for
timely settlement of high-value trades.
Governance & Compliance
Maintained audit-ready MIS dashboards (daily/weekly/monthly productivity reports) and timesheets for operational
transparency.
BCP Coordinator for the unit and member of Quick Response Team, ensuring seamless continuity during disruptions. • Managed the end-to-end implementation of regulatory requirements, including impact assessment, control/process changes, SOP updates, implementation, testing, and remediation.
Reviewed and updated policies, procedures and SOPs in response to regulatory requirements and process changes,


ensuring alignment with compliance and operational control standards. Supported Regulatory Assurance and compliance reviews, maintaining audit-ready documentation, evidence, control assessments, and remediation tracking. Partnered with relevant stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into operational controls and process changes, ensuring effective implementation and sustainable compliance.
• Member of the SharePoint SOP Committee, accountable for timely documentation and updates of all standard processes.
